settings.definition_quote: Let $\X \subset \Re^d$ be an arbitrary (finite or infinite) set of arms. When an arm $x\in\X$ is pulled, a reward is generated as $r(x) = x^\transp \theta^\star + \xi$ ... The arm set $\X$ is a bounded closed (and hence compact) subset of $\mathbb{R}^d$ such that $\|x\| \leq 1$ ... There exists $S\in\Re^+$ such that $\|\theta^\star\| \leq S$ and $S$ is known. ... conditionally $R$-subgaussian

unmapped: Link function continuously differentiable, k_mu-Lipschitz, with derivative lower bound c_mu > 0
settings.definition_quote: Every time an arm $x\in\X$ is pulled, a reward is generated as $r(x) = \mu(x^\transp \theta^\star) + \xi$, where $\mu$ is the so-called \textit{link function} ... The link function $\mu$ is continuously differentiable, Lipschitz with constant $k_\mu$ and such that $c_\mu = \inf (x^\transp \theta) > 0$.

source.quote: Under assumptions~\ref{asm:arm.set},\ref{asm:param.set},\ref{asm:subgaussian} and~\ref{asm:link.function}, the cumulative regret of \ts over $T$ steps is bounded as R^{\text{GLM}}(T) \leq \frac{k_\mu}{c_\mu} \big(\beta_T(\delta^\prime) + \gamma_T(\delta^\prime)(1 + 2/p) \big) \sqrt{ 2 T d \log \big( 1 + \frac{T}{\lambda} \big) } + \frac{2 k_\mu\gamma_T(\delta^\prime)}{p c_\mu} \sqrt{\frac{8 T } {\lambda} \log \frac{4}{\delta} } with probability $1-\delta$ where $\delta^\prime = \frac{\delta}{4T}$.
